analysis.verification: R1 independent re-validation: clean_i + compression_jpeg:1 reproduces degraded_i bit-exactly (PSNR=inf dB, all 10 content-independent CI metric diffs = 0.000) on all 5 support pairs (pair 0 == target, pairs 1-4 distinct; sha256 of every clean_i/degraded_i matches support_manifest.json).

compression.signal_rule: block_boundary > 1.05 -> JPEG (0% FP); signal present on 5/5 pairs

blur.note: slope_ratio < 1.08 on every pair, anisotropy 0 everywhere; gm_ratio varies with content/JPEG smoothing and is unreliable per SKILL C2. Adding blur_gaussian:1 before JPEG:1 breaks the match (26.75 dB, pair 2).

noise.note: sigma estimate is content-dependent JPEG pseudo-noise (0.37/0.62/0.74/1.48/2.97 across pairs). After stripping compression_jpeg:1 the residual is identically zero on all pairs (peeled_noise_check on the worst-case pair 3: std=0.0; §B extreme_pct=100% is the divide-by-zero artifact). Seeded noise candidates mismatch on sigma (YCrCb:3 diff=133%, YCrCb:1 diff=67%).

global.note: variance_ratio within 8% band on all pairs, mean_shift <= 0.2/255. The single saturation flag (pair 2, chroma_ratio=0.689) is JPEG chroma quantization on content: it is reproduced exactly by JPEG:1, and adding saturate_weaken_YCrCb:4 breaks the match (28.48 dB). residual_intensity_corr flips sign across pairs (+0.29/-0.24/+0.48/-0.07/+0.37) -> content artifact, not gamma; zero residual after JPEG:1 excludes any gamma component.

analysis.rationale: Single-step deterministic JPEG (compression_jpeg severity 1). Bit-exact reproduction on all 5 support pairs makes the pipeline unambiguous and excludes any additive/subtractive operator: a co-existing blur, noise, saturation or gamma step could not leave an identically zero residual. No cross-family alternative reached 30 dB (saturate+JPEG 28.48, blur+JPEG 26.75); compression_jpeg:2 is excluded by bit-exactness on all pairs (27.55 dB on pair 3) and left out of alternatives as an uninformative same-family severity variant.

r1_context.interpretation: The 32.13 dB support-pair model PSNR is not attributable to degradation-parameter error: the predicted pipeline reproduces the support targets exactly (PSNR=inf). Any residual gap is training/architecture-side and outside the scope of R1 parameter reflection.
